 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-openclaw-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out-4/play/users/u050/system/state/workspace/programs/task-f8533b14.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # The repeated 3-row color strip gives the colors of the vertical copies.
    colors = None
    for r in range(h - 2):
        row = grid[r]
        vals = [v for v in row if v != 0]
        if not vals:
            continue
        first = row.index(vals[0])
        last = w - 1 - row[::-1].index(vals[-1])
        seq = row[first:last + 1]
        if (all(v != 0 for v in seq)
                and all(grid[rr][first:last + 1] == seq for rr in range(r, r + 3))):
            colors = seq
            break
    if colors is None:
        raise ValueError('color strip not found')

    # Extract the central color-1 motif.
    pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 1]
    if not pts:
        raise ValueError('motif not found')
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in pts), max(r for r, c in pts)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in pts), max(c for r, c in pts)
    motif = [(r - r0, c - c0) for r, c in pts]
    mh = r1 - r0 + 1
    center = colors.index(1)
    start = r0 - center * mh

    out = [[0 for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    for i, color in enumerate(colors):
        top = start + i * mh
        for dr, dc in motif:
            rr, cc = top + dr, c0 + dc
            if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                out[rr][cc] = color
    return out
